entries.title: Job 29:1
segments: ¶Job further continued his discourse, and said:

entries.title: Job 29:2
segments: Oh, that I were as [in] months past, As [in] the days [when] God watched over me;

entries.title: Job 29:3
segments: When His lamp shone upon my head, [And when] by His light I walked [through] darkness;

entries.title: Job 29:4
segments: Just as I was in the days of my prime, When the friendly counsel of God [was] over my tent;

entries.title: Job 29:5
segments: When the Almighty [was] yet with me, [When] my children [were] around me;

entries.title: Job 29:6
segments: When my steps were bathed with cream, And the rock poured out rivers of oil for me!

entries.title: Job 29:7
segments: ¶"When I went out to the gate by the city, [When] I took my seat in the open square,

entries.title: Job 29:8
segments: The young men saw me and hid, And the aged arose [and] stood;

entries.title: Job 29:9
segments: The princes refrained from talking, And put [their] hand on their mouth;

entries.title: Job 29:10
segments: The voice of nobles was hushed, And their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.

entries.title: Job 29:11
segments: When the ear heard, then it blessed me, And when the eye saw, then it approved me;

entries.title: Job 29:12
segments: Because I delivered the poor who cried out, The fatherless and [the one who] had no helper.

entries.title: Job 29:13
segments: The blessing of a perishing [man] came upon me, And I caused the widow's heart to sing for joy.

entries.title: Job 29:14
segments: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me; My justice [was] like a robe and a turban.

entries.title: Job 29:15
segments: I [was] eyes to the blind, And I [was] feet to the lame.

entries.title: Job 29:16
segments: I [was] a father to the poor, And I searched out the case [that] I did not know.

entries.title: Job 29:17
segments: I broke the fangs of the wicked, And plucked the victim from his teeth.

entries.title: Job 29:18
segments: ¶"Then I said, 'I shall die in my nest, And multiply [my] days as the sand.

entries.title: Job 29:19
segments: My root [is] spread out to the waters, And the dew lies all night on my branch.

entries.title: Job 29:20
segments: My glory [is] fresh within me, And my bow is renewed in my hand.'

entries.title: Job 29:21
segments: "[Men] listened to me and waited, And kept silence for my counsel.

entries.title: Job 29:22
segments: After my words they did not speak again, And my speech settled on them [as dew].

entries.title: Job 29:23
segments: They waited for me [as] for the rain, And they opened their mouth wide [as] for the spring rain.

entries.title: Job 29:24
segments: [If] I mocked at them, they did not believe [it], And the light of my countenance they did not cast down.

entries.title: Job 29:25
segments: I chose the way for them, and sat as chief; So I dwelt as a king in the army, As one [who] comforts mourners.
